# Let users review exactly what an older backup will overwrite

## What & Why
The restore warning identifies changed areas, but users may still want to see which records or profile fields differ before making an irreversible choice.

## Done looks like
- The restore dialog offers a concise before-and-after view for each changed area.
- Answer and opportunity additions, removals, and edits are distinguishable without opening the backup file manually.
- The review remains usable on narrow screens and does not change saved data until confirmation.
